summary: Phase C (Fit Match Score), Phase D foundation (per-dimension narration), and Stock visibility tested end-to-end. Backend: 8 passed / 1 skipped on new pytest suite. Frontend: verified fit badges on Discover (3 of 4 cards rendered FitBadge in compact mode; shoes card correctly rendered NO badge), Item Detail badge renders with score, color band, 'Best size · X' text, narration chips, overall stock pill, and per-size stock chip. Recommended size auto-selects on first load. No critical issues found.
action_items: Optional: seed data has shirts with only partial per-size dimensions (only length_cm filled on existing shirts). The fit-score still works but narration chips are sparse for seed items. Consider enriching seed shirts in /app/backend/seed.py with full chest/shoulder/sleeve/length per size so QA without TEST_ items still sees rich narration.

Optional: TestFitScoreProfiles.test_seller_owned_profile_not_visible_to_buyer was skipped because POST /api/loved-ones returns 403 for sellers (RBAC). Cross-user isolation is still proven by the random-UUID 404 test.
critical_code_review_comments: fit_match.py is well-structured (≤220 lines, single responsibility, explainable algorithm with comments on sensitivity tuning).

items.py fit-score endpoint correctly: (a) does NOT 401 anonymous users — returns 200 scorable:false; (b) enforces user_id ownership on body_profiles lookup → 404 for cross-user/unknown profile_id; (c) routes /fit-score sits before catch-all /{item_id} pattern (works because the path has an additional segment).
FitBadge.tsx correctly returns null for unscorable items, preventing badge from rendering on shoes/accessories — verified at runtime (4 cards on Discover, 3 with badge, 1 without).
stock.ts intentionally hides exact qty > 5 ('In stock' instead of leaking inventory count) — matches spec.
Item Detail re-fetches fit-score on activeProfile change (useEffect dep on activeProfile?.profile?.id) — covers requirement to refresh badge when switching profile.

success_rate.backend: 100% (8/8 active tests passed; 1 skipped due to seller RBAC, not a bug)
success_rate.frontend: 100% (all required testIDs present and populated with correct data)

seed_data_creation: Test fixture creates a TEST_FitShirt (full per-size dims: S/M/L with chest/shoulder/sleeve/length and varying available_qty 8/3/0 to exercise out/low/in-stock bands) and TEST_FitShoes (no dimensions, qty 4/0) via the seller account, and cleans up at module end.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend test suite at /app/backend/tests/test_phase_c_fit_score.py is the canonical regression for fit-score. It creates its own deterministic TEST_ items (no dependency on seed data). To run: pytest /app/backend/tests/test_phase_c_fit_score.py -v. Frontend testIDs of note: item-card-{id}-fit, item-card-{id}-out, item-card-{id}-low, item-fit-badge, item-fit-row, item-stock-overall-{ok|low|out}, item-size-stock-{ok|low|out}, item-narr-{chest_cm|waist_cm|...}, item-size-{label}. Login flow: navigate to /login, fill data-testid='login-email-input' and 'login-password-input', click 'login-submit-btn'.
